---
name: code-review
description: Review pull requests in pi-mono by tracing changed Pi extension contracts, trust boundaries, provider lifecycles, and package-specific validation.
---

# Review affected extension contracts

1. Map changed paths to the owning package's `package.json` entrypoints and `AGENTS.md`. Use the root `AGENTS.md` command inventory; select current package names from manifests rather than old README filter examples.
2. Follow the affected contract through the implementation and tests below. Inspect adjacent consumers when a change alters a public result, configuration format, or lifecycle.
3. Run the smallest relevant one-shot checks from the owning package. Distinguish executed checks from source-only reasoning and unavailable integration prerequisites. An empty webfetch run or local-llm build is not behavioral test coverage.
4. Report a finding only when the changed code has an identifiable input/caller and a concrete adverse consequence supported by code or a reproduction. Separate pre-existing inconsistencies from regressions.

## Path-specific evidence

Test paths below are relative to the owning package.

| Changed area                                                          | Evidence and checks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `packages/agent-plugins/src/plugin.ts`, `marketplace.ts`, `config.ts` | Trace canonical-root containment, symlink escapes, trusted project configuration, fallback precedence, and sibling-failure isolation. Inspect `src/plugin.test.ts`, `src/marketplace.test.ts`, and `src/config.test.ts`.                                                                                                                   |
| Agent-plugins MCP adaptation                                          | Inspect `src/mcp.test.ts` and `src/mcp-integration.test.ts` for literal environment/header escaping, reserved variables, allowed remote URLs, deferred exposure, stable identities, and shutdown. Pi must retain transport/OAuth ownership.                                                                                                |
| Agent-plugins hooks/lifecycle                                         | Inspect `src/hooks.test.ts`, `src/hooks-integration.test.ts`, and `src/index.test.ts`. Trace dialect-specific decisions, validated argument replacement, bounded output/context, cancellation, and cleanup.                                                                                                                                |
| `packages/copilot/extensions/copilot.ts` and state                    | Inspect `extensions/copilot.test.ts` and `extensions/copilot/state.test.ts` for cached/offline and non-OAuth refresh, curated fallback, and publication without re-registration inside `refreshModels`.                                                                                                                                    |
| Copilot API/projection                                                | Inspect `extensions/copilot/{mapping,api,cache,catalog}.test.ts` and affected inference tests. Follow availability filtering versus whole-catalog fallback, field precedence, price units, limits, retries/cancellation, and malformed-store handling. Tests must isolate agent files and network.                                         |
| `packages/local-llm/extensions/`                                      | Compare the affected provider, shared config schema, manifest exports, and example JSON. Trace enabled-by-default behavior, non-destructive opt-out writes, next-start application, silent unavailability, and provider-specific endpoint shapes. Inspect `extensions/{discovery,providers}.test.ts`.                                      |
| `packages/sandbox/extensions/`                                        | Inspect `tests/{config,policy,runtime,tools}.test.ts` for fail-closed enabled execution, session/persistence separation, per-command snapshots, filesystem denials, environment grants, and timeout/abort/disposal. Use native/RPC suites when the affected contract requires them and prerequisites are available; see the package guide. |
| `packages/webfetch/extensions/webfetch.ts`                            | Trace schema/description/result consistency, HTTP(S) input restriction, cancellation, HTML versus images, truncation metadata, and render-cache/timer cleanup. Inspect `extensions/webfetch.test.ts` for the separate 5 MiB streamed-download limit, conversion, truncation, and cancellation.                                             |
| Shared tooling/catalogs                                               | Inspect `.oxlintrc.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, affected manifests, `tools/oxlint/anti-slop.test.ts`, and vendored provenance. Use `pnpm test:lint` for rule/harness changes; confirm host peer ranges and catalog resolution independently of development pins.                                                                          |
